name: Augmented Armor (General, Construct)
body:
Your physical body has an ablative outer layer.

Prerequisite(s) Construct or half-construct type and Armored Plating

Benefit(s) You gain DR 1/adamantine.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times, and its benefits stack. You may only take this feat once for every three Hit Die you possess.
